When an issue isn't valid or won't be fixed in this PR, reply in its thread with the reason and then resolve the thread. If appropriate, use sub-agents to investigate and fix each issue separately. P2: The stream treats any `{`-prefixed buffer as an object without validating the completed JSON. An incomplete or malformed payload such as `{` is forwarded and never replaced, so clients can still receive invalid `tool_use.input`; validate the completed buffer with `JSON.parse`/`isRecord` and emit `{}` when it does not produce an object. ```
Reply with feedback, questions, or to request a fix.

P2: The stream treats any `{`-prefixed buffer as an object without validating the completed JSON. An incomplete or malformed payload such as `{` is forwarded and never replaced, so clients can still receive invalid `tool_use.input`; validate the completed buffer with `JSON.parse`/`isRecord` and emit `{}` when it does not produce an object.

<summary>Prompt for AI agents</summary>

```text
Check if this issue is valid — if so, understand the root cause and fix it. When an issue isn't valid or won't be fixed in this PR, reply in its thread with the reason and then resolve the thread. At packages/backend/src/routing/proxy/anthropic-messages-adapter.ts, line 399:

<comment>The stream treats any `{`-prefixed buffer as an object without validating the completed JSON. An incomplete or malformed payload such as `{` is forwarded and never replaced, so clients can still receive invalid `tool_use.input`; validate the completed buffer with `JSON.parse`/`isRecord` and emit `{}` when it does not produce an object.</comment>

<file context>
@@ -376,12 +376,27 @@ function toAnthropicUsage(usage: unknown): JsonRecord {
+// '{' can grow into one. Hold every other prefix ("null", "[]", "true",
+// numbers, strings) and replace it when the block closes.
+function toolArgsAreNonObject(buffer: string): boolean {
+  return !buffer.trimStart().startsWith('{');
 }
```
